blocks.text: After all the years of waiting, Sleeping With Sirens is coming back to Asia! Presented by PULP Live World, the American post-hardcore powerhouse is set to return to the region with the SLEEPING WITH SIRENS ‘AN ENDING IN ITSELF TOUR ASIA 2027’, making stops in three cities in April 2027. The tour kicks off on April 13 at Capitol Theatre in Singapore, followed by Zepp Kuala Lumpur in Malaysia on April 15, before concluding in Manila, Philippines on April 17 at the New Frontier Theater.
